name: Challenge: Keyboard skip navigation stays on each current route and focuses real main content
description: Exercise the compiled local PixiBun build through user controls. Use a desktop viewport. Compare actual artwork and persistent state, not only element visibility. Missing prerequisites or unobservable cancellation must be reported rather than silently skipped.

planSteps.description: Press Tab before using any pointer input.
Verify Skip to content is the focused link.
Verify the URL remains the home route with #top and keyboard focus moves to its main content, without opening Studio.
Open Studio using the home page entry link.
Verify the Studio workspace has loaded.
Reload this page and press Tab before using any pointer input.
Verify Skip to content is focused on the Studio route.
Verify the URL remains /studio with #main-workspace and keyboard focus moves to the Studio main content.
